crop.notes: Whole 'Jack and Joe' Macon column, headline to signature, including the continuation at the top of column 2.

ocr.notes: Mostly readable but later sections have many garbled words.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch's Philadelphia correspondent Macon listed Tom Allen among the English fighters who had come to America, fought there and received fair treatment, in a column on Sullivan, Dempsey and Illingsworth.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Saturday, April 3, 1886, page 12.

notes: Allen appears only in a list of English pugilists who fought in America.
